Definition: from G1537 and G1670; to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin):--draw away.
BiblicalUsage: exélkō is a plain word for draw away. In James 1:14, the text says "when he is drawn away of his own lust."
TheologicalSignificance: In exélkō I find no hidden theology; it simply means draw away.
